Job description
Job Description:

Commercial Construction | Ground-Up & Interior Fit-Out Berks Construction GroupJob Type: Full-TimeWork Location:Compensation: $110,000-$180,000 per year, commensurate with experience. The Range is so broad based on Geographic Region, Candidates Qualifications and the Candidates' willingness to Travel. Berks Construction Group (BCG) is seeking an experienced Construction Superintendent to lead commercial construction projects in the field from preconstruction and mobilization through final completion and turnover. This is a field leadership position for an experienced construction professional who takes ownership of the jobsite, knows how to drive a schedule, holds subcontractors accountable, identifies problems before they become delays, and takes pride in delivering a high-quality project to the client. BCG is a multi-state General Contractor specializing in Retail, Big Box Retail, Restaurants, Medical Offices, Fitness, Health & Wellness, Dental, Urgent Care Facilities, and other commercial construction, including both ground-up construction and interior fit-outs/retrofits.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR The ideal candidate is an experienced commercial construction Superintendent who understands that successful field leadership requires planning, accountability, communication, technical construction knowledge, and attention to detail. Required ExperienceSignificant experience supervising commercial construction projects for a General Contractor.Strong experience with commercial ground-up construction and/or interior fit-outs and renovations.Demonstrated ability to lead subcontractors and field personnel.Extensive experience reading and interpreting architectural, structural, MEP, civil, and other construction drawings.Ability to identify discrepancies between drawings, specifications, field conditions, and subcontractor installations.Strong understanding of construction sequencing and means and methods.Experience coordinating inspections and project closeout.Valid driver's license.Ability and willingness to travel as required by project assignments.Authorization to work indefinitely in the United States without employer sponsorship. 10+ years of commercial construction supervision experience is strongly preferred. Preferred QualificationsOSHA 30 certificationProcore experienceExperience with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and ExcelCommercial retail construction experienceRestaurant construction experienceMedical/healthcare construction experienceFitness and wellness construction experienceGround-up construction experienceFast-track commercial fit-out experience
Job Type: Full-Time Pay: $115,000-$180,000 per year, based upon experience and qualifications. Travel: Travel to assigned project locations is required. Berks Construction Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
